messages:
Maria Chen: Quick kickoff — we need a focused copy pass for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages. Objective: make the three-mode value prop clearer for engineers and PMs, lock CTA routing for webinar signups, and prep the benchmark narrative for the blog post. 2-day turnaround?
Aj Patel: +1 on urgency. can we keep 1 hero line per mode and a shared section about economics (cost/latency tradeoffs)?
Samir Gupta: I can draft the benchmark blurb — highlight 40% cost reduction with batching + same P95 latency. Need approval on numbers from infra first.
Lia Park: For inbound routing: webinar signups -> sales demo for enterprise (dedicated/private) and trial for hosted. We should add hidden form field "mode_interest" with values hosted/dedicated/private.
Elliot (Design): I'll prepare hero treatments for the three pages. Quick question: do we want separate CTAs or a single multiselect flow?
Maria Chen: Separate CTAs that funnel to the same modal but pre-select the mode. UX wins and easier analytics.
Aj Patel: Draft copy idea for hero lines: Hosted: "Get started fast — hosted API, immediate results." Dedicated: "Predictable throughput, GPU-backed." Private: "Bring inference behind your VPC." Feedback?
Samir Gupta: Liking these. Slight tweak: emphasize SLOs for Dedicated: "SLA-backed latency". For Private: "Deploy in your VPC or on-prem."
Lia Park: For webinar routing, I'll map: CTA "Register" -> utm=webinar_mode_[mode], and for enterprise leads add an extra hidden property: "requires_sales": true for dedicated/private.
Maria Chen: Good. Also want a short benchmark callout under hero: "Benchmarks: median cost per 1k tokens down 40% vs baseline; P95 kept under 200ms" — Samir to confirm exact phrasing.
Samir Gupta: Confirming numbers — final: "Avg token cost 38% lower with caching & batching; 95th latency typically <220ms in our tests." Use that for now.
Elliot (Design): Noted. I'll create a compact badge variant for the benchmark copy.
Aj Patel: For the page body, propose sections: 1) Why inference matters (one-liner), 2) How Redwood serves (runtime + routing), 3) Economics + benchmarks, 4) Deploy options (hosted/dedicated/private with microcopy), 5) CTA + webinar modal.
Maria Chen: Keep microcopy for each mode to 1 sentence max. Writers: @Aj and @Samir pair up on mode microcopy. Lia do routing + form fields. Elliot do visuals and badge assets. I'll handle hero and page-level copy polish.
Lia Park: For forms, we should capture: email, company, company_size, mode_interest, use_case, utm_campaign. Also add a checkbox: "I'd like a demo" that triggers sales route.
Samir Gupta: One more thing — benchmark narrative for the blog: let's have a small methodology footnote: 8k seq, A/B vs baseline lib, 16-bit quantization on some models. I'll drop the draft into google doc.
Aj Patel: Draft microcopy attempt: Hosted: "Start building with our hosted API — low friction, pay-as-you-go." Dedicated: "Reserve GPU capacity for predictable throughput and SLAs." Private: "Full control: VPCs, KMS, and on-prem options."
Maria Chen: Clean. Make the voice slightly more direct: replace "Start building" with "Start building quickly".
Elliot (Design): Quick check on layout: do we want a shared hero with tabs or three separate pages under /product/hosted /product/dedicated /product/private?
Aj Patel: Separate pages -> easier SEO. Shared components though.
Lia Park: Agreed separate pages. I'll make sure the modal pre-selects mode based on the page path.
launch-bot: Reminder: Marketing content review deadline in 48 hours. Please add final drafts to the `/marketing/landing-copy` drive folder.
Maria Chen: Timeline: Day 1 — copy drafts + forms schema. Day 2 — design polish + dev handoff + embed analytics. Aim to publish by next Wednesday.
Samir Gupta: I'll upload benchmark draft by EOD.
Aj Patel: I'll send microcopy .md with CTAs and alt CTAs for A/B. Example CTAs: ["Get started", "Request a demo", "Explore hosted"]
Elliot (Design): I'll drop 3 hero visuals and badge SVGs into the folder.
Lia Park: Routing/analytics doc will include the utm matrix and Zapier/webhook destinations for sales.
Maria Chen: Perfect — we'll reconvene tomorrow at 10am sync to review final copy. :thumbsup:
Aj Patel: Thanks all — quick wins: make hero lines active voice, add benchmark badge, ensure forms capture mode_interest.
Samir Gupta: Noted. Ping me if infra needs to re-run benchmark for slightly different model settings.
Elliot (Design): Will do.
launch-bot: Task created: "Landing copy final review" assigned to Maria Chen, due in 48h.
